block.comment: Purpose: Read serial bytes and echo them so Monitor works in both directions. Hardware: use Connections to check pin ownership for your selected board. Open the comment bubbles on the main steps for explanations.

block.field: Ready. Type in Monitor and press Send.
block.comment: Send this value/text to the computer. A new line finishes one record; same line can build a record from several values. Match Monitor/Plotter baud to the sketch.
Runs once after power-on or reset. Initialise the program here; repeating measurements and animation belong in loop.
Evaluate the condition first. Execute the enclosed actions only when it is true; otherwise skip them or use the else branch.
Repeats until power is removed. Each block runs in order, then execution returns to the top. Keep this loop responsive when servicing motors, music or serial input.
